pages.text: Lay tanned leather on the $(item)Shaping Rack$() and use shears or a knife on it. Hold the button to draw the blade along the pattern, and let go on the end mark. Two cuts make two $(item)Leather Panels$() of the leather's ★. A cut far off the mark can ruin it into scraps.
pages.title: Cutting

pages.text: Panels make straps and hardened leather (waxed with honeycomb), and RPG leather armor.
